memory_candidates.content: verify-deploy.sh's positional TARGET_REPO argument must be the repo root (containing both agent-system/extensions and .claude), not an extension subdirectory -- it defaults to $(pwd) when omitted. Gate 3 (doc-lint) and gate 5 (manifest parity) specifically test for $TARGET/agent-system/extensions. Passing an extension subdir path (e.g. agent-system/extensions/core) as TARGET produces 'no deploy tree at .../.claude -- nothing to verify' (exit 2), not a doc-lint failure.

generate-context-line-counts.sh must be invoked from the DEPLOYED scripts tree (.claude/scripts/generate-context-line-counts.sh), not the source-store copy (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/...) -- the source-store copy's own relative-path root resolution assumes a deployed depth and errors loudly rather than silently miscounting. Running the deployed copy correctly writes line_count corrections back into the SOURCE STORE's index-entries.json.
